title: Extension tests must isolate the Windows profile and use a platform-absolute path
goal: Two susi-config extension tests are host-dependent: with_temp_home sets HOME and XDG but not APPDATA, so on Windows the tests share one config directory and race on state.json (truncated JSON failures), and the absolute-path rejection test uses /etc/passwd, which Windows does not resolve, so the absolute path is not rejected. Set APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA in the temp home and choose a platform-absolute fixture.
